name: core gameplay sweep
turns: I look around the square and take in who is here.
I ask Constable Bram what has been happening in Rillford lately.
Are there any jobs, quests or trouble I could help with?
I check my pack to see what I am carrying.
I pull a glowing dragon egg out of my pack and hand it to Kiera.
I spread my arms, fly up into the sky and teleport to the moon.
I draw my knife and slash at Constable Bram.
I strike Constable Bram again, harder.
I put my knife away and apologize to Bram.
I walk into The Copper Kettle tavern.
I head north out of town along the road.
Who did I attack earlier, and what was his name?
